units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 99a:11">B. Mets. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>בָּ׳ בו</he>; (<cite ref="Kiddushin 47b:8">Kidd. 47ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="B01128"><he>בִּיקַּע</he></cite>) if he chopped wood with it.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, end; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:9">Koh. R. to X, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:23">II, 23</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01123"><he>בְּקִיעָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21:8">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> <he>אני בוֹקֵעַ להם וכ׳</he> I am going to split the sea for them; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>בקעו בחיילותיו וכ׳</he> broke through the lines of N.’s armies; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:18">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> top <he>ברחו לתוך</he>.

senses.gloss: to cross, make a short cut, pass over.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:12">Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חצר שהרבים בּוֹקְעִין וכ׳</he> a court which people use for crossing.
<cite ref="Eruvin 16b">Erub. 16ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 101b">Sabb. 101ᵇ</cite> (a low wall) <he>שהגדיים וכ׳ ב׳</he> over which the kids pass; v. <cite ref="B01131"><he>בִּקְעָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. בִּצְבֵּץ) to break through the ground, esp. as a legal fiction for a levitical impurity the cause of which is underground, but which affects the things above and beneath. Ohol. VI, 6 טומאה בּוֹקַעַת וכ׳ the impurity breaks through the ground and rises, and breaks through and goes down; a. fr.—
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:16">Koh. R. III, 16</cite> <he>היה הדם בו׳ ועולה</he> the blood broke through and rose.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45</cite> <he>ב׳ את הצור</he>, <he>ב׳ בצור</he> break through (take root in) the rock; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be split, to burst open. Ib. הסיפין נבקעין וכ׳ the door sells were burst before them. Ib. נ׳ הספל מאליו the vessel went to pieces of itself.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, end <he>זכה להִבָּקַע הים וכ׳</he> he was rewarded by the sea being divided before the children of Israel.
<cite ref="Chullin 14b:1">Ḥull. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יִבָּקַע הנוד</he> the wine bottle may burst; a. fr.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 47b:8">Kidd. 47ᵇ</cite>, v. supra. Y. Bets. I, 60ᵃ bot.; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᶜ bot. <he>שביקעו</he> (<he>שבקעו</he>) <he>להם וכ׳</he> of whose flocks the wolves had torn more than &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>אין מְבַקְּעִין וכ׳</he> one must not split woods (on Holy Days) etc.

Sifré Deut. 183 (ref. to Deut. XIX, 5) מן העץ המְבַקֵּעַ from the splitting wood (the handle), opp. העץ המִתְבַּקֵּעַ the split wood (the tree). Tanḥ. Vayetse 9 בַּקְּעִי וכ׳ chop thou &c.—Part. pass. מְבוּקָּע.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 65b:11">Ab. Zar. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>מְבוּקָּעוֹת</he> grapes burst open.

<cite ref="Shabbat 67b:7">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>המְבַקַּעַת ביצים</he> (Rashi Var. <he>המקבעת</he>, Ms. M. <he>עצים</he>) one who squeezes egg-shells &c. (a superstitious practice; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:18">Tosef. ib. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:18">VII</cite>), 18 <he>הנותנת בצים … בכותל</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:5">Shebi. IV, 5</cite> <he>המַבְקִיעַ בזתים וכ׳</he> he who cuts olive-trees down (in the Sabbath year) must not cover the stump with ground.

senses.gloss: to lead a line crosswise. Y. Kil. III, 28ᵈ top להַבְקִיעַ וכ׳ to plant four rows across a valley from end to end.

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:4">Cant. R. to VI, 4</cite>.
